# Independent matrix and inventory review

Git apply --check passed.

The matrix raw diff contains exactly five case additions, autocomplete #180 and input #113–116; no removals or other raw matrix changes. On the actual AST, the maintained test independently derived 2329 records and compared removal of those five with the entire prior 2324-record roster, including IDs, order, and metadata. Five new cases map to actual added test declarations. Inventory raw diff contains only the two expected current candidate hashes and complete prior candidate snapshots; current execution remains not-executed, bound_to_current_head false. The final inventory SHA-256 is 912def47c1e171f9c2a01906dcc0968b91c5288d9b8f73714247b0319f3a2b15. No tagged reference, golden, or allowlist change is in the patch.

Examined the Git-backed chain 04daa4f8c → c051c2d → fd1c105 → 6b88db2 → c3f0513f. The five watched product paths match Git before/after through the source guards; input spec separately remains ab1073120be461d9451eaed8bc3c83768d3c5a60f8ca55c854ae471f7e19e289 through c051, becomes adaa537dbaf11af77b3526d6abfd5cb6950979e727bf9a170ff40fc74859bd31 at fd1c, and b6698d0bc2d680b0d2732736d2386199b1c499693fbc1c645350ab29d5036a33 at 6b88. The first product commit changes the two autocomplete paths; the second changes form-field and input spec; the third changes input source and spec.

Ran pinned Node 24.21.0 and Python 3.14.7 maintained test in a separately populated minimal fixture: 1 test passed (7.433 s). It runs real AST derivation and JS probe, compares Python/JS frame bindings, and exercises forged metadata/reader, old inventory as current, historical comparison, per-path physical tampering, late/cross-callback drift, swallowed reentry, proxy/getter/toJSON, symlink, and -O / PYTHONOPTIMIZE fail-closed controls. Initial fixture setup omitted runner dependencies and then used old test files; both initial runs failed for fixture setup reasons and were corrected before the passing run. No canonical files were modified. These source-level controls and metadata do not constitute historical execution, product behavior qualification, G11, TOOL, global CI, or peer support admission. Source successor was outside this independent review.
